faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is conducted by the National Dope Testing Laboratory (NDTL) for filling up administrative positions on a deputation basis in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for NDTL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post announced in this notification is Deputy Director (Admin) under advertisement number 03/2026, offering 1 vacancy for eligible administrative professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Deputy Director (Admin) position at the National Dope Testing Laboratory for qualified candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this job?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form through the proper channel is 02 December 2026, within 60 days from the publication date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for NDTL Deputy Director?
faq.answer: The mode of application is offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed proforma (Part-A, Part-B, and Part-C) and send it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a UGC/AICTE recognized University or Institute with relevant experience in administration, establishment, or finance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for NDTL Deputy Director?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 56 years as calculated on the closing date of receipt of applications for the deputation role.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary corresponding to Pay Level 11, ranging between Rs. 67,700 and Rs. 2,08,700/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be forwarded through the Cadre Controlling Authority and sent to the Director, NDTL, East Gate No 10, JLN Stadium Complex, New Delhi 110003.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, and a penalty statement along with the application form.
